body_html:
Got up a few hours early this Christmas to buil a plugin for Read Posts plugin for Known. Here is a example post: https://quickthoughts.jgregorymcverry.com/2018/12/25/flow-the-psychology-of-optimal-experience-1

Here is the repo if you want to add the plugin to your Known site: https://github.com/jgmac1106/Known-Read

To add to your site simply clone this repository to your IdnoPlugins subdirectory of your Known installation, using the directory name Read, and enable the plugin.
